producer_path.supported: Worker read selects socket path. Read task R retains socket; ReadData describes buffer/count. Zero-time g_socket_condition_check first checks poll; otherwise GSocket source created IN|HUP|ERR and attached through R. Existing initial R may predate observer.

Exact native loads socket.private+0x18, FD+0xc. GSocketSource size0x78: tag+0x60,socket+0x68,condition+0x70; source holds socket ref. Unix tag is allocated GPollFD. Source prepare only consults wrapper closed state; dispatch queries tag.revents unless wrapper closed. Kernel-side close bypassing wrapper state is not proved by this code.

R captures initiating thread-default context; source callback retains R and attaches to R.context. Exact native task+0x40 context/source+0x20 context; callback/R/worker and ReadData correlation recover preobserver task identity without inventing creation event.

GPollFD stored in source private fds, attached nonblocked sources enter context poll records. Context adds EVFILT_READ/WRITE/EXCEPT registrations to its own kq. Registration kevent return is ignored by pinned source; presence in userspace list is not proof successful kernel registration.

When context poll_func==g_poll and HAVE_KQUEUE, kevent on context.kq returns events; translation compares numeric FD to ev.ident, sets matching GPollFD revents. Socket source dispatch masks events and invokes read-ready callback/R. Native code confirms context.kq+0xcc,poll_func+0xb8,poll_records+0x78,nrecords+0x80.

Pinned child recovery sets context kq=-1, removes wakeup poll, creates new kqueue and wakeup, and adds wakeup poll. This sequence alone does not prove which recovery ran, the lifetime of selected read source, or why normal mode failed. Inherited positive control remains authoritative.

exact_binary_evidence.all_contexts_recovery: Context creation native0x1b7ed4..0x1b7ef0 publishes GSList at base+0x1bef758. Read-only enumeration can find a source matching exact socket AND callback/task/worker, without injecting getters or assuming gmain thread identity.

native_contract.status: design-only; no native dispatch authorized by this offline slice
native_contract.question: Does the already-selected pending socket read have a valid correlated GSource registration on its actual GMainContext, and what does that same context return/dispatch after the complete selected host write?
native_contract.immutable_inputs: Frida 17.24.3 exact wheel/agent; final fixture.py, probe.py, observe.py, run_case.py and requirements unchanged from accepted transport report. Four-second arming, twelve-second progress deadline unchanged; normal close_fds=True and root instrumentation unchanged.
preflight: One free retained native macOS ARM64 worker and one persistent authenticated Upterm connection, only after parent authorizes native slice.
Exact artifact hashes/UUID, actual attach/read/detach and every proposed site live-byte equality; no inferior function execution or register writes.

Capture all-threads-stopped read-only snapshot at existing selected-worker snapshot/connection call entry. Bound list traversal to 256 contexts, 256 priority lists/context, 4096 sources/context; any unreadable, cycle, reciprocal-link or bound failure fails observation rather than claiming absence.
snapshot: Resolve selected worker+0x60 socket as accepted; read socket+0x18 private and signed private+0xc FD. Record private flags raw; never equate wrapper closed-bit false to OS FD validity.

Read global GSList at base+0x1bef758; each node data=context,next=+8. Enumerate context+0x58 source_lists.head; GList data=GSourceList,next=+8, list head at +0x20, GSource next+0x48, context+0x20. Match exact source_funcs base+0x1bc0db0 and socket source+0x68 equal selected socket, not FD number alone.

For matched source verify normal callback_funcs base+0x1bc11d0. Callback_data source+0 points to GSourceCallback: function+8=base+0x173d44, data+0x10=R. Verify R.source_object+0x18=selected socket, callback+0x60=base+0x1736b4, callback_data+0x68=selected worker, taskdata+0x30 ReadData buffer/count equal selected worker buffer+cur and wanted-cur. Verify R.context+0x40=source.context+0x20.

Read source tag+0x60 as GPollFD (fd i32+0, events u16+4, revents u16+6; handle+8). Require matching FD and tag membership in source.private(+0x58).fds(+0x18), and same GPollFD pointer in context.poll_records(+0x78; node fdptr+0,next+0x10). Record source flags/refcount/id and destruction/block flags, with source definitions. Require exactly one fully correlated pending read source; zero/multiple/unreadable is failed identity gate, no causal conclusion.

Record selected context.kq signed+0xcc, poll_func+0xb8, n_poll_records+0x80. Crosscheck via same-context native poll sites, not thread name. The earlier gmain EBADF queue is a different unproven identity until this comparison is observed.
observations: Arm selected-context poll entry, kevent before/return/errno-pointer and socket-source dispatch before continuing; keep existing exact host write and read/dispatch chain. No unfiltered global hot-path logging.

At poll entry x0 filter equals recovered context; take one coherent source/tag/poll record snapshot while that context is locked. At kevent return record every returned event ident/filter/flags/fflags/data plus selected GPollFD revents before/after translation; track entry/return per thread and actual call instance.

Optional registration observation only if a new source naturally arms: capture original kevent call and return; absence of a preobserver registration is explicitly unproven, not failure or successful registration. Do not restart the read to manufacture it.

At source dispatch require exact recovered source and R; record callback, event bits, then existing receive/result/errno-aware observations. Source destruction/task free must retire identity before reuse. No claims for arbitrary FD reuse or preobserver interpreter queues.

Avoid tight EBADF breakpoint storms: observation time/callback budget exhaustion is harness failure. Keep raw counts for all observed selected-context calls and a declared bounded capture ceiling; exceeding it is loss, never zero drops.
sequence: Unchanged inherit control must validate new source/context identity and actual event→source dispatch→16+16 read→matched reply chain within original deadlines. This is the sole necessary newly-instrumented control, not a repeat of broad accepted tests.

Only after control passes, one unchanged normal close_fds diagnostic with original deadlines and one exact selected reply. Stop at conclusive outcome; no fresh negative repetition. Incremental harness-only correction on same worker retains every failure.
Detach agent at existing all_complete before exec; retain host/agent sources, commands and raw outcomes, then complete process/directory/SSH/provider cleanup and manifest-verified archive.

predicates.control_pass: All correlation/readability/live-byte gates plus actual inherited event/source/read/reply/exec chain and deadlines pass.
predicates.normal_observation_pass: Full exact identity is observed; actual selected-context calls/events/source dispatch are captured with matched entry/return and no truncation, alongside actual complete selected host write. Normal fixture may still fail unchanged.
predicates.unproven: Missing identity, source absent at snapshot, no selected-context poll call, missing return, no kernel object identity, unsupported external FD inspection or any dropped/truncated observation remains unproven. Event absence cannot prove why.
predicates.cause_limit: A negative kqueue result with actual errno on the positively matched context localizes an invalid/erroring readiness consumer. It does not establish who closed/reused any FD, prove peer identity, prove kernel byte availability/loss or justify a production fix.

native_contract.responsible_completion_source: GLib GMainContext selected kqueue consumer translates EVFILT_READ/EOF/error into the correlated GPollFD revents; GLib source dispatch invokes read-ready with R. That callback owns socket receive and task completion.
unsupported_actions: No fcntl/poll/getsockopt calls in inferior, no changed descriptor inheritance, new socket/read, altered lifecycle call, dependency/source patch, extended deadline or debugger across exec.

retrieval: Read this committed JSON from a clean checkout, base64-decode archive.base64 into a fresh owned scratch file, then verify archive.size and archive.sha256. Validate unique relative regular paths and every length/hash in manifest.json.entries. Retained binary excerpts, pinned source relationships and raw validation records support the mapping; they do not establish live selected-context state, successful kernel registration or a defect.
